name: IPRATROPIUM / SALBUTAMOL NEBULIZATION SOLUTION 10 AMPOULES
description: Nebulizer solution with ipratropium and salbutamol is used to treat reversible bronchospasm, often associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Ipratropium is an anticholinergic and salbutamol is a beta2 agonist, which together relax the airways to facilitate breathing. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
